name: project-rules
description: Load CLAUDE.md and path-scoped rule files (.zcode/rules/*.md with paths: globs) into ZCode sessions, so projects coming from Claude Code or Cursor keep their instructions. Hooks only, no network.

description_i18n.en: Load CLAUDE.md and path-scoped rule files (.zcode/rules/*.md with paths: globs) into ZCode sessions, so projects coming from Claude Code or Cursor keep their instructions. Hooks only, no network.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 将 CLAUDE.md 与按路径生效的规则文件 (.zcode/rules/*.md, 支持 paths: glob) 注入 ZCode 会话, 让从 Claude Code 或 Cursor 迁移的项目保留原有指令. 仅使用 Hook, 不访问网络.
